name: Tattoos Body Piercings
overview: Scripture clearly instructs believers to refrain from marking their bodies with tattoos or cuts as a sign of mourning, emphasizing holiness and separation from pagan customs (Leviticus 19:28; Deuteronomy 14:1). While ornamental adornments like earrings and crowns are acknowledged (Ezekiel 16:12), the explicit prohibition against bodily marks for the dead underscores a call to honor God with our bodies. This teaching reminds Christians to maintain physical purity as a reflection of their identity as children of the LORD.
